Let me know if you need anything else—unless you need my favorite joke, in which case, I’m always ready!

And just to keep the good vibes going: Why did the t-shirt get promoted? Because it was outstanding in its field!

No worries—I’ll hop online and place the order myself. Thanks for all your help and for being such a good sport with my jokes! If you ever need a laugh, you know who to call. Have a great day!
